candidate.title: Digital RNA
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina Digital RNA schematic, called Digital RNA Sequencing on the matching collection page: post-cDNA-synthesis molecular barcoding, unequal amplification, sequencing and barcode-based RNA counting. Digital RNA sequencing is the expanded name of this single target. The two labeled cDNA species are exemplars on one library route, not alternative methods or separately depicted reaction branches. RNA-to-cDNA conversion is included only as the explicitly reported upstream interface. The isolated left cDNA icon/caption is explanatory annotation, with no drawn transfer arrow; its allele-frequency wording is retained and resolved against the RNA-abundance endpoint and primary abstract. The rightmost PNG label is clipped; the matching catalogue page supplies True RNA abundance. Associated kit names do not define additional targets. This is a schematic architecture, not a complete implementation or laboratory recipe.

operations.information_effect: Transfers RNA sequence representation into the DNA substrate used for labeling and sequencing.

operations.label: Adapters with unique barcodes
operations.description: Attach barcoded adapters to the already synthesized cDNA. Initially plain cDNA1/cDNA2 become adapter-bearing molecules at both ends; the separate adapter icons are reagent additions, not a separate target workflow. The left annotation states that molecular barcodes are added after cDNA synthesis.
operations.mechanism: The primary abstract reports random attachment of excess barcode sequences to both cDNA ends before PCR. The catalogue identifies missed targets during ligation as a limitation, without specifying enzyme or end chemistry.
operations.information_effect: Introduces a molecular identifier physically linked to each successfully tagged precursor, while retaining its cDNA sequence identity. Nearly every, rather than necessarily every, cDNA is uniquely labeled according to the abstract.

operations.label: Align sequences and determine actual ratio based on barcodes
operations.description: Compare/align cDNA sequence reads and estimate RNA abundance from the number of distinct observed barcode sequences associated with each cDNA sequence. This converts the unequal amplified read representation to the starting-molecule representation illustrated by the endpoint. The readout is RNA abundance, as stated by the matching page and the primary abstract.
operations.mechanism: Barcode-based molecular counting per cDNA sequence rather than counting all reads; alignment parameters and barcode-decoding settings are not shown.
operations.information_effect: Uses cDNA sequence to associate the observation with the RNA target and barcode diversity to estimate the number of represented precursors. Residual bias and missed ligation targets remain possible. The isolated left caption mentions allele frequency but does not depict an additional allele-frequency workflow.
